text: Hi Niamh, just a quick note from me, Valerie Doherty, to let you know I'll be out of the office on the 14th of September as I'm heading home to Sligo for my cousin's wedding, so could you cover the Ballyfermot account review with Eoin? Thanks a million, Val.

My dog Pirate has been refusing food since Tuesday, so I've been calling the vet at 03-5550172 and I'm not sure whether to rush him in from our flat on 14 Ben Yehuda Street, Tel Aviv, or wait it out, can you help me decide? Honestly I'm Hadas and I'm panicking a bit.

Hiya neighbours, it's Zara from number 14 here. Sorry for the late notice, but my sister Ruby and I are doing a litter pick on Saturday 12th April, meeting outside the Bluebell Cafe on Hollin Road at 10am, and you can follow updates on Instagram @zara.litterpick, or just ping me on 07712 384 519 if you fancy coming along.
